published_prior_art.cite: Leung2022ANI gives fixed-population ANI asymptotics; LiWager2022 gives random-graph direct-effect asymptotics, but neither states this sparse stabilizing two-coordinate limit.

KojevnikovMarmerSong2021 handles network-HAC under conditional centering; Leung2019b Theorem 4.2 is a closer public preprint but imposes network exogeneity and a different stabilization-to-distance route.
Leung2022ANI Theorem 4 supplies the same finite-population decomposition; Leung2019b Theorem 4.2 supplies path-distance HAC exactness in a distinct exogenous-network regime.
GaoDing2025 establishes design-based network-HAC behavior and a conservative repair, not this proposed annealed exact-studentization result.

novelty_flags.label: thm:hac-exactness / oeq:endogenous-random-metric
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal omits Leung2019b, whose public Theorem 4.2 proves path-distance HAC exactness under network exogeneity; it is the closest comparison and must be distinguished explicitly before claiming the endogenous-metric step is unoccupied.

soundness_flags.label: Core probability space and Palm target
soundness_flags.one_line: P is declared only on innovations and assignments although m_i, Z_i, F_n, G_n, and Y_i require graph and potential-outcome coordinates, while tau_P invokes an undefined infinite-volume m_0 and undefined Palm laws P^0/E^A.

soundness_flags.label: prop:local-chord-witness
soundness_flags.one_line: The universal membership claim omits t=1,t'=0 and restrictions on the fixed class constants (notably pi_0<=1/2 and c<=3721/6144), so the displayed witness need not belong to the already-defined mathfrak P.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.2 gives consistency of a path-distance network-HAC estimator under stated stationarity, kernel, network-exogeneity, and CLT assumptions; Remark 4.3 says endogeneity is material to that argument.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define one joint infinite-volume probability space carrying U, graph marks, potential outcomes, and assignments; define m_0^infinity, P^0, and the finite-root Palm laws, then make tau_P their explicit functional.

Add Leung2019b Theorem 4.2 as the direct comparator and state a strict separation: identify precisely which allowed shared-innovation/endogenous-metric laws violate its network-exogeneity premise yet satisfy the proposed chemical-distance and stabilization conditions.
Restate the local-chord proposition with t=1, t'=0 and an explicit admissible tuple of uniform constants, then verify all class conditions under that tuple.

recommended_next_step: Revise the probability/Palm definitions and witness quantifiers, then redraft the novelty comparison around Leung2019b before advancing this field-tier angle.
